caseName: Turner Broadcasting System, Inc. v. Federal Communications Commission
caseNameFull: Turner Broadcasting System, Inc. v. Federal Communications Commission

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. D. C. Probable jurisdiction noted. Brief of appellants is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, November 9, 1993. Briefs of appellees are to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, December 7, 1993. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Tuesday, December 21, 1993. This Court’s Rule 29 does not apply.
